artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan authoring the context tier-semantics standard, its additive index entry, and the DERIVED_TIER back-pointer comment

memory_candidates.content: When a documentation task must register a new file in a source-store context index whose entries carry an exact line_count gate (check-extension-docs.sh Rule R), the phase order is forced: author the file to completion first, then wc -l it, then write the index entry. Splitting authoring and registration into separate phases with an explicit dependency is not bureaucratic overhead -- it is what makes the line_count a measured fact rather than an estimate. The same shape applies to any index/manifest whose entries assert a measurable property of the file they point at.
